questions.question: What do you generally do on weekends?
followUps: What do you enjoy most about your weekends?
Do you usually plan your weekends in advance or decide as you go?

questions.question: How would you describe your typical day, from morning to evening?
followUps: Which part of your day do you enjoy the most?
Does your usual routine leave you enough time to relax or do things for yourself?

questions.question: Do you like socializing?
followUps: Do you prefer having a small circle of close friends or knowing lots of people?
How often do you like to meet friends or socialise?

questions.question: Do you prefer going out and exploring places, or spending a quiet day at home?
followUps: What kinds of places or activities do you most enjoy when you go out?
On a free weekend, how often would you ideally like to go out?

questions.question: Outside work, what are the things that matter most to you in your life right now?
followUps: Which of those things would you most like to make more time for?
How do you usually make time for the things that matter to you?

questions.question: What kind of behaviour from other people puts you off?
followUps: Can you give an example of a behaviour that would make it difficult for you to trust someone?
How do you usually handle it when someone behaves that way?

questions.question: Do you usually open up to people quickly, or does it take you time to get comfortable with them?
followUps: What helps you feel comfortable enough to open up to someone?
Does that change once you've known someone for a while?

questions.question: When you have an important decision to make, do you prefer figuring it out yourself or discussing it with people close to you?
followUps: Whose perspective do you usually find most helpful when making a big decision?
Can you think of a time when discussing a decision helped you see it differently?

questions.question: Are you happy with your current career, or is there something you'd like to change or achieve?
followUps: What would you most like to change or achieve in your career?
Is there a particular professional goal you'd like to work towards over the next few years?

questions.question: How important is career growth to you compared with having a comfortable work-life balance?
followUps: What would a good work-life balance look like for you in practice?
When work gets demanding, how do you like to manage your time outside work?

questions.question: How do you imagine balancing work and family responsibilities after marriage?
followUps: How do you think household responsibilities should be shared if both partners work?
What kind of support would you expect from your partner during a particularly busy period at work?

questions.question: What are your biggest financial priorities at this stage of your life?
followUps: Are you generally someone who likes to save money, spend on things you enjoy, or maintain a balance between both?
Are there any major financial goals you're currently working towards?

questions.question: After marriage, how do you think a couple should manage their household expenses?
followUps: Would you prefer to share expenses equally or contribute in proportion to each person's income?
How do you think a couple should decide who pays for which household expenses?

questions.question: Do you think married couples should combine their finances, keep them separate, or have a mix of both?
followUps: Would you be comfortable having a shared account for household expenses alongside individual accounts?
How important is it to you that each partner maintains some financial independence?

questions.question: What would financial stability mean to you in practical terms—for example, owning a home, having savings, being debt-free, or being able to travel comfortably?
followUps: Which of those financial goals would be your highest priority?
Would you prefer to plan and work towards those goals jointly as a couple?

questions.question: After marriage, how do you imagine balancing time with your own family and your partner's family?
followUps: How often would you ideally like to visit or spend time with each side of the family?
How would you handle it if both families had important events on the same day?

questions.question: What are your thoughts on living with parents after marriage versus living separately?
followUps: What factors would matter most to you when deciding whether to live together or separately?
Would your preference change if either set of parents needed more support or care in the future?

questions.question: Are there any family traditions or customs that are particularly important to you and that you'd want to continue after marriage?
followUps: Are there any particular festivals or customs you'd especially want to continue?
How would you feel about adapting traditions if our families celebrated things differently?

questions.question: How much involvement do you think parents should have in a married couple's personal decisions?
followUps: Which decisions do you think should be made privately by the couple?
How would you handle it if a parent strongly disagreed with a decision you made together?

questions.question: When you think about marriage, what would you hope everyday life with your partner would be like?
followUps: What small everyday things would help you feel happy and connected with your partner?
How would you ideally like to spend time together on a normal weekday?

questions.question: What are the most important things you're looking for in a life partner?
followUps: Which of those qualities matter the most to you?
Are there any expectations you think are especially important to discuss before marriage?

questions.question: How important is it for you to have your own personal space and independence after marriage?
followUps: What does having personal space look like for you in everyday life?
How would you balance time together with individual hobbies or friendships?

questions.question: How important is it for you to live close to your parents and family after marriage?
followUps: What distance or travel time from your family would feel comfortable to you?
Would you want to live close to both families, or would practical factors make one location more suitable?

questions.question: Would you prefer buying a home as soon as it's financially practical, or are you comfortable renting for a few years?
followUps: What would make you feel ready to buy a home?
When choosing where to live, how would you weigh location against the financial flexibility of renting?

questions.question: What things do you think a husband and wife should always be able to discuss openly with each other?
followUps: Are there topics that couples often find difficult to discuss but should still be able to talk about?
How would you bring up a topic if you were worried it might lead to disagreement?

questions.question: If something is bothering you in a relationship, do you usually bring it up immediately or take some time to process it first?
followUps: What helps you process your feelings before having that conversation?
How would you let your partner know that you need some time before discussing an issue?

questions.question: If you and your partner strongly disagree about something, how would you prefer to resolve it?
followUps: What helps keep a disagreement respectful when both people feel strongly?
If neither person changes their mind, how do you think a couple should decide what to do?

questions.question: When you think about your future, what are some things you'd really like to have in your life?
followUps: Which of those things feels most important to you right now?
Is there anything you'd particularly like to experience or accomplish in the next few years?

questions.question: What kind of lifestyle would you ideally like to have in the future—more focused on career growth, family time, travel, financial freedom, or a mix of these?
followUps: What would an ordinary week look like in that ideal lifestyle?
Which part of that lifestyle would you prioritise first?

questions.question: How would you feel if our priorities changed over time—for example, if one of us wanted to change careers, start a business, or pursue further education?
followUps: How would you decide together whether the change was worth the financial or practical risk?
What support would you hope to receive from your partner during that transition?

questions.question: What's your heritage? Were you born here and did you grow up here?
followUps: What do you like most about the place where you grew up?
Has the place you grew up shaped any of your interests, traditions, or lifestyle?

questions.question: How important are religious or spiritual beliefs in your life?
followUps: Do your beliefs influence your everyday decisions or routines?
Have your beliefs or practices changed as you've grown older?

questions.question: What role would you like religion or faith to play in your married life?
followUps: Are there any religious practices you'd want to continue or share with your partner after marriage?
Would you want faith to guide major family decisions, or would you see it more as a personal matter?

questions.question: Would you expect your partner to follow the same religious practices as you, or are you comfortable with differences?
followUps: Are there any particular practices you'd hope your partner would participate in?
How would you approach a difference in how often each partner practises their faith?
